page_title: WOL 1-0 WHU | Wolves v West Ham 01/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Tony Harrington has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
90+2' The ball is behind the touchline and West Ham will take a throw-in.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jean-Ricner Bellegarde leaves the pitch and Boubacar Traore (Wolves) comes on.
88' Matt Doherty (Wolves) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Tony Harrington ignores the protests.
85' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
84' A cross from a corner kick by Wolves is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
82' Rayan Ait Nouri comes off the pitch to be replaced by Santiago Bueno (Wolves).
81' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
80' Tony Harrington shows a yellow card to Joao Gomes (Wolves) for a tough tackle.

78' Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) meets a delightful cross into the box, and from near the penalty spot he plants a strong header towards the top left corner. The keeper makes a decent save to deflect the ball onto the post.
77' That will be all from Oliver Scarles who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Emerson (West Ham).
77' Here is a change. James Ward-Prowse is going off and Graham Potter gives the last tactical orders to Tomas Soucek (West Ham).
74' The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
73' Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) attempts to discuss the decision with Tony Harrington, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
71' The manager makes a subsitution with Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) coming on for Andre.
69' A sweet pass inside the box gives Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
68' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for West Ham.
66' The number of shots on goal at present is 2:1.
63' The linesman signals a throw-in for Wolves.
61' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
59' Wolves will take a free kick from near the half-way line.

57' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Tony Harrington blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. A free kick to West Ham.

54' What a chance that is! Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
52' Wolves keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
50' The ball has crossed the sideline. Wolves are taking a throw-in.
48' West Ham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
46' Graham Potter prepares a substitution. Aaron Cresswell is replaced by Carlos Soler (West Ham).
46' Graham Potter decides to make a substitution. Evan Ferguson will be replaced by Edson Alvarez (West Ham).
46' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) will replace Luis Guilherme.
46' The whistle blows and Tony Harrington starts the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Joao Gomes (Wolves) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
45+1' 5:4 – the total goal attempt statistics.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
42' The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
39' Andre (Wolves) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
36' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Wolves was in an offside position.
35' Wolves are seeing far more of the ball now.
32' The referee blows his whistle, West Ham are awarded a corner kick.
31' Jose Sa (Wolves) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Tony Harrington's book.
31' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) uses bad language while talking to the referee and receives a yellow card for dissent.
28' A yellow card for a tackle by Andre (Wolves). Tony Harrington doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
27' OFF THE BAR! Joao Gomes (Wolves) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes off the woodwork. What a strike that was!
25' Matt Doherty (Wolves) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to West Ham.
23' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) commits a rough foul. Tony Harrington stops the game and makes a call.

21' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Alphonse Areola. He makes it 1:0.
19' The ball is laid off to Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the bottom right corner and forces Jose Sa to make a decent save.
19' That was close by Emmanuel Agbadou (Wolves)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.

17' Toti (Wolves) leaps highest around the penalty spot to meet a cross from the free kick and produces a promising goal-bound header towards the right post, but Alphonse Areola pulls off a fine save to deny him.
16' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) brings his opponent down. Tony Harrington has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Wolves have a free kick.
15' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
13' Evan Ferguson (West Ham) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.

12' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance! The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
10' Rough tackle by Emmanuel Agbadou (Wolves). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
8' The ball possession at the moment is 65:35.

5' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Tony Harrington no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Wolves.
3' The ball is out of play. Wolves will have a throw-in.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
West Ham will kick-off.
Tony Harrington got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
